title: Bachelor of Arts (B.A.)
description: Our B.A. program offers a comprehensive liberal arts education designed to develop critical thinking, strong communication skills, and a deep understanding of human culture and history.

title: Master of Arts (M.A.)
description: The M.A. program provides advanced theoretical and practical knowledge in arts and humanities, preparing students for research, academia, and professional leadership.
